beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Job had asked God hard questions. And God answered — not with explanations, but by taking Job back to the very first morning.

timing.text: Job had asked God hard questions.
And God answered — not with explanations, but by taking Job back to the very first morning.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Before there were people to suffer or to doubt,

timing.text: Before there were people to suffer or to doubt,

beats.speaker: god
beats.text: Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth? declare, if thou hast understanding.

timing.text: Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth?

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Tell me, if you know. It sounds severe until you notice what it really does — it lifts Job's eyes off his own wreckage and sets them on something older and steadier than his pain.

timing.text: It sounds severe until you notice what it really does — it lifts Job's eyes off his own wreckage and sets them on something older and steadier than his pain.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: And when that happened, something astonishing broke out in the sky.

timing.text: And when that happened, something astonishing broke out in the sky.

beats.speaker: god
beats.text: When the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?

timing.text: When the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The stars themselves broke into song. Creation was not a cold accident — it was a celebration.

timing.text: The stars themselves broke into song.
Creation was not a cold accident — it was a celebration.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The God who sang the world into being is the same one listening to your questions today.

timing.text: The God who sang the world into being is the same one listening to your questions today.

card.text: The stars sang when the world began. Your story is still being written by the same hand.
